title: fix(replay): support source-pin checks on older Git
body:
## Summary

Repair source-pin validation on Git versions that reject `cat-file --batch -z`, as reported in #2721 and the retained P104 obstruction package.

```text
git_blobs
  try the existing NUL-delimited batch
  if the first response is absent and Git exits 129
    retry once with the line-delimited batch
    resolve CR/LF paths to exact object IDs first
```

Exact blob IDs, SHA256 pins, live-input equality and catalogue checks are unchanged. Supported Git retains one process and no version cache.

[Scope, source pins, reproduction and predecessor credit](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/73406fd73ebaf8361b51674fad5e0b02a26db075/research/git-batch-compatibility). TASK records the verifier-engineering override from the picker suggestions, priority revision 5 and submission overlap. Base `7ef5f7150476fdf995b286b9cdbed262c631939c`; compatibility checked against canonical main `34588a98dabb668d4c53e5e776cd7b3927174d26` with unchanged relevant guidance and inputs.

## Evidence

- Before: the existing R439 package's `--check-only` exits 1 on a real Git 2.34.1 build with `unknown switch 'z'`. The new regression tests fail too.
- After: the identical package and source objects pass on Git 2.34.1 and 2.47.3.
- Registered replay passes all 17 focused tests on both Git versions. These cover binary/empty/Unicode inputs, CR/LF path safety, SHA256 object IDs, failure controls, bounded retry and child cleanup.
- All 80 `test_research_*.py` tests pass on both versions under CPython 3.12.15.
- The unchanged pin-batching verifier passes all 12 controls; its modern-Git benchmark retains one process for both source inventories. Selected-record binding passes.
- New tests pass Ruff; two unchanged runner diagnostics are documented. Compilation and `git diff --check` pass.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/git-batch-compatibility
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
python3.12 -I -B research/research-package-pin-batching/verify.py
```

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** registered replay. This changes the shared blob reader, so its opt-in package checks should run. No selected frontier, frozen scientific input or source hash is changed. No new kappa or supplier claim.

Windows, other Git versions and full selected cold replay were not run. Existing synchronous pipe-read deadline limitations remain outside this repair.
